title: A guide is key at the cathedral
text: Having a guide at the cathedral made all the difference in our experience. Otherwise, it would have been a long wait with little idea of what we were seeing in the third largest cathedral in the world.  We were able to get in quickly and focus on the key features while learning the story of the artwork. We even got a perfect lunch recommendation from our guide off the main tourist area at the end of our tour.
author: AnneMarie_S

title: You will not be disappointed.
text:
Beautiful place to visit whilst in Seville.
Please book online well ahead or you will be disappointed. If you are keen observer, please allow yourself time to see the magnificent carved columns, walls, etc. Beautiful tapestries, painting... Lots to see. Also not forgettind the climb up to the tower. Need to be fit for this. Google review pictures does not do any justice so I have not included them purposely.
Best advise.. book in advance and buy a package with cathedral visits and Alcazar.
author: PratapV19

title: One of the Best Tours Ever!
text: We had originally planned to see the Cathedral “on our own”, but decided to take a tour at the last minute—and we were so glad we did!!!  Our tour guide, Alberto, made the Seville Cathedral come to life!!!!  Alberto was one of the best tour guides I have ever had the pleasure of touring with.  He is an art history expert and his passion for the subject matter made this tour so memorable for our entire family. title: Magnificent visit!!
text: On the occasion of the visit of some friends from outside we hired the tour and we have no regrets. The guide was friendly and had a lot of knowledge, we learned a lot about the history and art of the cathedral. We will definitely repeat with your other routes.

title: Guided tour of Cathedral and Alcazar
text: It was a magnificent visit, excellent guide who gave us all the details of the monuments and also answered all the questions of the group. It is certainly the best way to learn and also enjoy.

title: Cathedral and Alcazar Guided Tour
text: I am from Seville and we took this guided tour together with some friends who came from outside. We were delighted with the content, detail of the explanations, etc. All very dynamically and without being heavy. We will certainly repeat again.

title: Good tours and best guides
text: I couldn't have learned so much about the Cathedral and the Alcazar going free. The visit is very well organized and our guide Eva was wonderful. I recommend 100% because apart from this visit they offer many more walking tours and excursions equally interesting. We'll be back!
